title.zh: Perplexity Computer 可从旧任务轨迹里提炼可复用技能
title.en: Perplexity Computer can turn earlier task traces into reusable skills

summary.zh: Perplexity 展示 Computer 的 Brain：一个任务完成后，另一个过程读取轨迹，提炼可复用内容到私人技能，用户可选启用。官方披露的小样本 SkillLearnBench 有 16 个配对案例，成功率从 43.8% 到 62.5%。这是官方产品演示与小样本数字，不能写成普遍收益。同窗口流传的 GUARD 论文讨论的是冻结模型、用保留样例防止 harness 回归，不是 Perplexity 的产品功能，不记入这条。
summary.en: Perplexity showed Computer's Brain: after a task finishes, another process reads the trace and extracts reusable content into a private skill that the user can choose to enable. Official SkillLearnBench figures cover 16 paired cases, with success rising from 43.8% to 62.5%. That is a small official sample, not a general gain. The GUARD paper circulating in the same window is about freezing the model and using held-out examples to stop harness regressions; it is not a Perplexity product feature and does not belong on this leaf.

brief.zh: Perplexity 展示 Computer 可从完成任务的轨迹里提炼私人技能，由用户选择启用。官方小样本成功率从 43.8% 升到 62.5%。
brief.en: Perplexity showed that Computer can extract private skills from finished task traces, which users can enable. An official 16-case sample rose from 43.8% to 62.5% success.

why.zh: 这是可验证的产品能力演示；小样本数字要保留，但不能推广成普遍收益。
why.en: A verifiable product demonstration. Keep the small-sample figures, and do not treat them as a general gain.
